name: checkbox
title: Checkbox
description: Square check box and a labelled checkbox row with description; indeterminate supported.
whenToUse: Use it for one yes-or-no choice in a form that is saved later. For a setting that applies at once use Switch; for several related choices use Checkbox group.

parts.name: Checkbox
parts.description: The box: 18px, square, never cut. Checked fills ink with a paper tick; indeterminate draws a bar. Inside a yellow (working-set) cell the tick turns yellow, so the box keeps contrast on both fills. All Base UI Checkbox props pass through (name, value, form participation, parent/child groups); `onCheckedChange` gets Base UI's event details last. Without children it draws its CheckboxIndicator.

parts.name: CheckboxField
parts.description: A labelled checkbox row: box cell + label + optional description. The whole row is the hit target, the label is the accessible name, and the description is attached via aria-describedby (Base UI Field). `className` goes to the row's Field.Root; every other prop goes to the Checkbox.

props.name: layout
props.description: control (default): aligns to a form column. cell: a row inside an enclosing frame (40px box cell, inset text).

parts.name: CheckboxIndicator
parts.description: The tick (checked) or bar (indeterminate). Kept mounted by default, so the box's contents never jump.
